title: OA–BMD–Fracture cross-trait Mendelian randomization: analysis code and harmonised summary statistics
description: Reproducible analysis code and harmonised per-SNP summary statistics for the cross-trait Mendelian randomization study 'Bone Mineral Density and Osteoarthritis Share Genetic Architecture but No Evidence of a Causal Pathway from Osteoarthritis to Fracture' (13 skeletal phenotypes: 2 OA definitions, 10-site BMD, any fracture). Includes the strict PLINK-equivalent clumping pipeline, two-sample MR (IVW, MR-Egger, weighted median), MR-PRESSO, LDSC genetic-correlation matrix, power calculations, sample-overlap diagnostics (rho_GE), and the completed MRlap sample-overlap correction for all ten exposure-outcome pairs (R 4.6.1). All statistics are recomputed from publicly published GWAS; no individual-level data are redistributed.
